newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Tea Smallholder up on growth prospects.
newsitem.headline: Tea Smallholder up on growth prospects.

text.p: Shares of Sri Lanka's Tea Smallholder Factories Ltd (TSML) rose 2.13 percent or 50 cents to 24 rupees on Tuesday on better growth prospects in 1997, brokers said.
"Being in the tea sector, the company is expected to see good profits in 1997," said a broker who declined to be identified.
TSML's net for nine months to December 31, 1996 was 49.5 million rupees, up from 36.42 million in the same previous period.
Plantations which did well in 1995 and 1996 due to record high tea prices should perform well in 1997 too, analysts say.
The company processes tea leaf bought from small cultivators. -- Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
